prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a minimal glossy red latex micro brief of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering him, paired with a black leather chest harness of thin crossing straps with silver ring hardware, his chest and stomach otherwise fully visible.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
